posts.text: Why the ₹34,700 cr TAM is wrong: Wrong choice one — using total waste generation as tradeable supply. posts.text: A rule called Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) makes the company that manufactures a product responsible for ensuring that its waste is collected and recycled after use. Companies that recycle waste receive recycling certificates, with each certificate representing a specific quantity of waste that has been properly recycled. Companies that are unable to meet their recycling obligation can instead comply by purchasing these certificates.
